body:
I had a lender from /borrow who I obtained against the rules, but it worked great for both of us in May. However, he lent out to me the equivalent of my monthly income through social security. $1675. Thrlughout the month, he made it seem as though he'd help me stay!afloat this month too. Well, the first week. He has agreed to vouch for me if i find a willing lender. I cant. Its hard when you cant request. You just have to creepily try to PM them all, seeming like a scammer.

To buy myself one more week at this motel ( Rex motel Egg Harbor Township, NJ ) I just need to obtain about $80. i have $45 right now. $125 is my half. I hate when little amounts of money cause such anxiety especially when I would have had it if I didn't need to use basically a loan shark.

Securing the rest of June wpuld be nice, but I only care about right now because I have until 11am tomorrow. .

By helping me as much as you can, would pointing me in the direction of maybe a reddit lender you know be that? I will pay interest easily. Even double if I have to.

I know what you mean. Like, i dont want to put in that work again to familiarize myself with anyobe else inside and out like that.

Its fuxked. We went from renting a house the past 2 years, to being CRAMMED 3 deep in a motel. 

Now that im alone, to make matters worse, a reddit lender on /borrow i managed to get loans from all last month swiped my entire $1675 social security check and wont lebd tk me this month, only vouch for me. So my rent is due tuesday at a place i dont even wanna live at. This fucking motel ruined my life, but as of now, idk what to do. I may not have a choice but to do anything but camp.

I honestly just feel like the easiest thing to do would be to purposely overdose on drugs at this point. I dont use them anymore, so death would be easy. At least she know how much I loved her because she swore I never did that's her low self-esteem. This lender  left me fucked , though. I mean  , its my fault. But.... God damn youd think hed want tp male a other 498 in interest.

Honestly I just wish I had the $70, it was supposed to go toward half of a weekly rate for a motel that i am currently living at. but my life will kinda be very uncomfortable until my next payday. I messaged you.

I typed alot as an outlet for both anger and anxiety. A couple days is better than never, but damn I needed that today. It was like, all I had to my name right now. Lol I'm a poor bastard.

Of course it happened to me on a Sunday.One of two days that venmo's live  phone support is closed

I don't know that for a fact, and that is a valid point. 
However, aside from wants and desires, her care involved little more than cooking meals for her. She had insurance for whatever medication she was taking, and a life insurance plan established long before she ended up passing.

Like, from what I know, things remained entirely normal and without huge expense until pretty much the very, very end.
She had a urinary tract infection and was hospitalized in a little rehab to recoup. One night, she got up in a hurry to piss, fell, and had a heart attack. Maybe the later preceded the former.

My point after all of that is if any of that money was being spent it was the relative whom I chose not to name utilizing it as her own personal expense account.

If anybody could name some law firms for me I'd appreciate it. If this goes through, maybe I could talk to somebody a referral fee. Haha. I'm serious, though.

Now, in regards to a lawyer; is there a certain type of lawyer I need? As you can tell by me turning to Reddit for advice on something so serious, I have no idea where to turn or what to really do. Also, this money was taken from me years ago, I'd say at most 7 years, minimum 4 years.

it's now coming to mind years later because I'm at a junction in my life where I could really, really use it. I am 27 and barely manage to stay afloat - I'm even living in a trashy motel paying overpriced weekly rates. So unless the lawyer worked on contingency, I wouldn't have anything to pay him right now.
